d: From Robert Oppenheimer’s nuclear fear and the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki to the 1954 Castle Bravo hydrogen bomb test and the Lucky Dragon No. 5 tragedy, Godzilla was never just a monster movie—it was a nation’s trauma given form. In this episode of Rough Copy on Khabargaon, Aman explores the complete history and hidden meaning behind Toho’s 1954 Godzilla (Gojira), directed by Ishiro Honda and produced by Tomoyuki Tanaka. Discover how special effects pioneer Eiji Tsuburaya invented "Suitmation" using a 100kg suit worn by Haruo Nakajima in 60C heat, how composer Akira Ifukube…
